result.topic_en: Transformation of a ternary quadratic form into a sum of three weighted squares (principal axes), deriving the cubic equation for the eigenvalues G and an expression for the direction coefficient α.
result.transcription:
$G(\alpha x+\beta y+\gamma z)^2+G'(\alpha' x+\beta' y+\gamma' z)^2+G''(\alpha'' x+\beta'' y+\gamma'' z)^2$
$=Axx+Byy+Czz+2ayz+2bxz+2cxy$
$(A-G)\alpha+c\beta+b\gamma=0$
$c\alpha+(B-G)\beta+a\gamma=0$
$b\alpha+a\beta+(C-G)\gamma=0$
$\{a(A-G)-bc\}\alpha=\{b(B-G)-ac\}\beta=\{c(C-G)-ab\}\gamma$
$[-a-]\frac{A-G}{a(A-G)-bc}+\frac{c}{b(B-G)-ac}+\frac{b}{c([-B-]C-G)-ab}=0$
$\frac{bc}{a(A-G)-bc}+\frac{ac}{b(B-G)-ac}+\frac{ab}{c(C-G)-ab}+1=0$ #
$\frac{a(A-G)}{a(A-G)-bc}+\frac{b(B-G)}{b(B-G)-ac}+\frac{c(C-G)}{c(C-G)-ab}=2$
$(A-G)(B-G)(C-G)+2abc=aa(A-G)+bb(B-G)+cc(C-G)$
$\alpha=\sqrt{\frac{1}{1+\left(\frac{a(A-G)-bc}{b(B-G)-ac}\right)^2+\left(\frac{a(A-G)-bc}{c(C-G)-ab}\right)^2}}$
Setzt man
$\frac{bc}{a(A-x)-bc}+\frac{ac}{b([-B-]B-x)-ac}+\frac{ab}{c(C-x)-ab}+1=\Omega$
so wird indefinite[?]
$(a(A-x)-bc)(b(B-x)-ac)(c(C-x)-ab)\Omega=-abc(x-G)(x-G')(x-G'')$
Differentiirt man und setzt nach der Differentiation $x=G$, so wird
$(a(A-G)-bc)(b(B-G)-ac)(c(C-G)-ab)\,abc\left\{\frac{1}{(a(A-G)-bc)^2}++\right\}$
$=abc(G-G')(G-G'')$ woraus
$\alpha=\sqrt{\frac{\{b(B-G)-ac\}\{c(C-G)-ab\}}{(a(A-G)-bc)(G-G')(G-G'')}}$ Die Schlüsse bedürfen
eine Abänderung, wenn eine der Grössen a, b, c verschwindet; die Gleichung
# wäre dann eine identische

methods.what: Representation of a ternary quadratic form as a weighted sum of three squares of linear forms (principal axis transformation)
methods.quote:
$G(\alpha x+\beta y+\gamma z)^2+G'(\alpha' x+\beta' y+\gamma' z)^2+G''(\alpha'' x+\beta'' y+\gamma'' z)^2$
$=Axx+Byy+Czz+2ayz+2bxz+2cxy$

methods.what: Linear eigenvector equations for coefficients α, β, γ
Rational form of the characteristic equation
Factorization of the characteristic expression in terms of roots G, G', G''
Differentiation at x=G to obtain closed form for α

items.quote:

items.english: The conclusions require a modification if one of the quantities a, b, c vanishes; the equation # would then be an identity.
